description: The segment lengths of this project run to the mating face of the cable connectors (Settings > Project, Segments are measured to), as a mechanical model gives them; W002-P2 is measured to its rear. The depth of each connector part and of the backshell W001-A1 on W001-P1 is taken off each wire, so a wire length stays a length from rear to rear. The length model adds a cut allowance and the take-up of twisting. Look at the length note, segments.csv and explain DIR W001-001; the manual page Lengths to the face explains it.
name: Lengths to the face (EXAMPLE)
